# Beggy

Swiggy. But the food is fake. You keep the money.

URL: https://beggy.vercel.app/
Tagline: Order it. Track it. It never comes.

Beggy is a free fake food-delivery simulator for India. You browse kitchens, see a real-looking bill (GST, platform fee, surge), place an order, watch a rider for 11 minutes, then the food never arrives and the rupees stay in your account.

No accounts. No real payments. No real restaurants. Savings live in the browser unless the user shares a challenge link.

Challenge URL:
https://beggy.vercel.app/?c=AMOUNT&dish=DISH&from=NAME
Example: https://beggy.vercel.app/?c=610&dish=Butter+Chicken&from=Priya

WhatsApp preview for that URL must read:
Priya just didn't order butter chicken — ₹610 kept

Creator: Arunachalam Venkatachalapathy (Bengaluru). Optional UPI tip after a save: arunking156-2@oksbi
